summary: Describes how GMPLS can control two types of Ethernet switching defined for Metro Ethernet Forum and ITU G.8011 services. It specifies how GMPLS is used to set up such Ethernet services across the network.

eli5.summary: Companies buy Ethernet services that act like private wires between sites. This explains how a single control system can set up those wires on the network switches.

questions: gmpls support for metro ethernet forum services
